title: 28 July 2010: Paul McCartney live at Time Warner Cable Arena, Charlotte
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Time Warner Cable Arena in Charlotte, North Carolina, USA, on 28 July 2010.

It was the 18th concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011. This show was seen by 15,477 fans.

Here’s a performance of ‘Ram On’, from Paul and Linda McCartney’s 1971 album Ram:

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
